# Contributors

Thanks to everyone who contributes to **Cozy World**! 🌿

Your feedback, bug reports, code improvements, tests, and ideas help make this project better.

## 🌱 Core Maintainer

- [@neotwis](https://github.com/neotwis) — Creator and maintainer of Cozy World.

## 🤝 How to Contribute

Contributions are welcome! You can help by:

- Reporting bugs and suggesting features through [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/neotwis/cozy-worlds/issues).
- Improving documentation and examples.
- Submitting bug fixes and new features through Pull Requests.
- Adding tests and improving reliability.
- Sharing feedback about procedural world generation, terrain, biomes, weather, and game content.

## 🚀 Contribution Guidelines

1. Fork the repository.
2. Create a branch for your changes.
3. Make your changes and add tests when appropriate.
4. Run the existing test suite with `npm test`.
5. Submit a Pull Request describing your changes.

Please keep contributions focused, well-documented, and compatible with the project's existing API where possible.

## 💚 Thank You

Every contribution, big or small, is appreciated. Thank you for helping Cozy World grow!
